blockingIssues.problem: The description says appointments from 7 to 21 August may be attended "at any time during opening hours," which contradicts the source's instruction that Saturday appointment holders must enter Gate C within the time printed on their booking.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "From 7 to 21 August they must enter through Gate C, within the time printed on their booking."
blockingIssues.constraint: The source requires arrival within each booking's printed time window; the description cannot broaden this to any time during opening hours.
